panels.title: Success rate (all jobs)
panels.description: Indicator 3: share of finished jobs that ended in 'done'

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'done') / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('done', 'failed')), 0) AS "success %" FROM jobs WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Avg QoP (images)
panels.description: QoP = 0.4*norm(PSNR) + 0.4*SSIM + 0.2*norm(sharpness_output/sharpness_bicubic), min-max over the jobs in the selected time range (research memo, Sprint 5). The trained model in analytics/ uses bounds from its training split.

targets.rawSql: WITH q AS (SELECT j.id, j.created_at, j.mode, max(m.value) FILTER (WHERE m.name = 'psnr_db') AS psnr, max(m.value) FILTER (WHERE m.name = 'ssim') AS ssim, max(m.value) FILTER (WHERE m.name = 'sharpness_output') / NULLIF(max(m.value) FILTER (WHERE m.name = 'sharpness_bicubic'), 0) AS gain FROM jobs j JOIN metrics m ON m.job_id = j.id WHERE j.kind = 'image' AND j.status = 'done' AND $__timeFilter(j.created_at) GROUP BY j.id, j.created_at, j.mode), g AS (SELECT * FROM q WHERE psnr IS NOT NULL AND ssim IS NOT NULL AND gain IS NOT NULL), n AS (SELECT *, 0.4 * COALESCE((psnr - min(psnr) OVER ()) / NULLIF(max(psnr) OVER () - min(psnr) OVER (), 0), 0.5) + 0.4 * LEAST(GREATEST(ssim, 0), 1) + 0.2 * COALESCE((gain - min(gain) OVER ()) / NULLIF(max(gain) OVER () - min(gain) OVER (), 0), 0.5) AS qop FROM g) SELECT avg(qop) AS "QoP" FROM n
SELECT avg(m.value) AS "PSNR, dB" FROM metrics m JOIN jobs j ON j.id = m.job_id WHERE j.kind = 'image' AND j.status = 'done' AND $__timeFilter(j.created_at) AND m.name = 'psnr_db'
SELECT avg(m.value) AS "SSIM" FROM metrics m JOIN jobs j ON j.id = m.job_id WHERE j.kind = 'image' AND j.status = 'done' AND $__timeFilter(j.created_at) AND m.name = 'ssim'

panels.title: Indicator 1 — throughput by mode (images)
panels.description: Average megapixels per second of model inference, 2K vs 4K

targets.rawSql: SELECT j.mode AS "mode", count(*) AS "jobs", round(avg(m.value)::numeric, 2) AS "avg MP/s" FROM jobs j JOIN metrics m ON m.job_id = j.id AND m.name = 'megapixels_per_second' WHERE j.kind = 'image' AND j.status = 'done' AND $__timeFilter(j.created_at) GROUP BY j.mode ORDER BY j.mode

WITH q AS (SELECT j.id, j.created_at, j.mode, max(m.value) FILTER (WHERE m.name = 'psnr_db') AS psnr, max(m.value) FILTER (WHERE m.name = 'ssim') AS ssim, max(m.value) FILTER (WHERE m.name = 'sharpness_output') / NULLIF(max(m.value) FILTER (WHERE m.name = 'sharpness_bicubic'), 0) AS gain FROM jobs j JOIN metrics m ON m.job_id = j.id WHERE j.kind = 'image' AND j.status = 'done' AND $__timeFilter(j.created_at) GROUP BY j.id, j.created_at, j.mode), g AS (SELECT * FROM q WHERE psnr IS NOT NULL AND ssim IS NOT NULL AND gain IS NOT NULL), n AS (SELECT *, 0.4 * COALESCE((psnr - min(psnr) OVER ()) / NULLIF(max(psnr) OVER () - min(psnr) OVER (), 0), 0.5) + 0.4 * LEAST(GREATEST(ssim, 0), 1) + 0.2 * COALESCE((gain - min(gain) OVER ()) / NULLIF(max(gain) OVER () - min(gain) OVER (), 0), 0.5) AS qop FROM g) SELECT mode AS "mode", count(*) AS "jobs", round(avg(psnr)::numeric, 2) AS "avg PSNR, dB", round(avg(ssim)::numeric, 3) AS "avg SSIM", round(avg(gain)::numeric, 2) AS "sharpness gain", round(avg(qop)::numeric, 3) AS "avg QoP" FROM n GROUP BY mode ORDER BY mode

panels.title: Indicator 3 — success rate and time by kind
panels.description: Share of successful jobs and average processing time, photos vs videos

targets.rawSql: SELECT j.kind AS "kind", count(*) AS "total", round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE j.status = 'done') / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) AS "success %", round(avg(m.value)::numeric, 2) AS "avg seconds" FROM jobs j LEFT JOIN metrics m ON m.job_id = j.id AND m.name = 'processing_seconds' WHERE j.status IN ('done', 'failed') AND $__timeFilter(j.created_at) GROUP BY j.kind ORDER BY j.kind

panels.title: QoP per job
panels.description: QoP = 0.4*norm(PSNR) + 0.4*SSIM + 0.2*norm(sharpness_output/sharpness_bicubic), min-max over the jobs in the selected time range (research memo, Sprint 5). The trained model in analytics/ uses bounds from its training split.

targets.rawSql: WITH q AS (SELECT j.id, j.created_at, j.mode, max(m.value) FILTER (WHERE m.name = 'psnr_db') AS psnr, max(m.value) FILTER (WHERE m.name = 'ssim') AS ssim, max(m.value) FILTER (WHERE m.name = 'sharpness_output') / NULLIF(max(m.value) FILTER (WHERE m.name = 'sharpness_bicubic'), 0) AS gain FROM jobs j JOIN metrics m ON m.job_id = j.id WHERE j.kind = 'image' AND j.status = 'done' AND $__timeFilter(j.created_at) GROUP BY j.id, j.created_at, j.mode), g AS (SELECT * FROM q WHERE psnr IS NOT NULL AND ssim IS NOT NULL AND gain IS NOT NULL), n AS (SELECT *, 0.4 * COALESCE((psnr - min(psnr) OVER ()) / NULLIF(max(psnr) OVER () - min(psnr) OVER (), 0), 0.5) + 0.4 * LEAST(GREATEST(ssim, 0), 1) + 0.2 * COALESCE((gain - min(gain) OVER ()) / NULLIF(max(gain) OVER () - min(gain) OVER (), 0), 0.5) AS qop FROM g) SELECT created_at AS "time", qop AS "value", mode AS "metric" FROM n ORDER BY created_at

SELECT j.created_at AS "time", m.value AS "value", j.mode AS "metric" FROM metrics m JOIN jobs j ON j.id = m.job_id WHERE j.kind = 'image' AND j.status = 'done' AND $__timeFilter(j.created_at) AND m.name = 'psnr_db' ORDER BY j.created_at

panels.title: Per-job quality (input features + QoP)
panels.description: Same columns as analytics/export_features.sql: the data the QoP regression learns from

targets.rawSql: WITH q AS (SELECT j.id, j.created_at, j.mode, j.original_filename, fi.width, fi.height, fi.size_bytes, max(m.value) FILTER (WHERE m.name = 'sharpness_input') AS sharpness_input, max(m.value) FILTER (WHERE m.name = 'psnr_db') AS psnr, max(m.value) FILTER (WHERE m.name = 'ssim') AS ssim, max(m.value) FILTER (WHERE m.name = 'sharpness_output') / NULLIF(max(m.value) FILTER (WHERE m.name = 'sharpness_bicubic'), 0) AS gain FROM jobs j JOIN files fi ON fi.job_id = j.id AND fi.role = 'input' JOIN metrics m ON m.job_id = j.id WHERE j.kind = 'image' AND j.status = 'done' AND $__timeFilter(j.created_at) GROUP BY j.id, j.created_at, j.mode, j.original_filename, fi.width, fi.height, fi.size_bytes), g AS (SELECT * FROM q WHERE psnr IS NOT NULL AND ssim IS NOT NULL AND gain IS NOT NULL), n AS (SELECT *, 0.4 * COALESCE((psnr - min(psnr) OVER ()) / NULLIF(max(psnr) OVER () - min(psnr) OVER (), 0), 0.5) + 0.4 * LEAST(GREATEST(ssim, 0), 1) + 0.2 * COALESCE((gain - min(gain) OVER ()) / NULLIF(max(gain) OVER () - min(gain) OVER (), 0), 0.5) AS qop FROM g) SELECT created_at AS "time", original_filename AS "file", mode, width, height, size_bytes AS "input bytes", round(sharpness_input::numeric, 1) AS "input sharpness", round(psnr::numeric, 2) AS "PSNR", round(ssim::numeric, 4) AS "SSIM", round(gain::numeric, 2) AS "sharpness gain", round(qop::numeric, 3) AS "QoP" FROM n ORDER BY created_at DESC
